FULL TEXT:
Extension of last date for submission of Application and Amendment in Terms &
Conditions – Engagement of Bank’s Medical Consultant (BMC) on Contract Basis
with Fixed Hourly Remuneration at Reserve Bank of India, Bhopal
Please refer to our notification dated August 21, 2026 on the captioned subject.
2. The last date for submitting the application has been extended up to 05:00 PM on
September 25, 2026.
3. The rate of fixed hourly remuneration has been revised (with effect from October 01,
2026) as ₹1400/- per hour for MBBS Doctors with upto 20 years of experience and
₹1800/- for MBBS Doctors with more than 20 years of experience and MD Doctors for the
entire period of contract i.e. three (03) years (As per total working hours).
4. The contract will be terminable during the period of contract, on three months’ notice
on either side or three months’ remuneration as payable per hour per Bank working days
in lieu thereof.
5. All other conditions and eligibility criteria mentioned in the notification dated August
21, 2026 will remain unchanged.
6. Any amendment / corrigendum regarding this recruitment, if any, will be uploaded on
the Bank’s website only.
Regional Director
Reserve Bank of India, Bhopal
